phase_prompt.label: The Silent Array
phase_prompt.summary: The Host stands in waiting within the upper data-strata, a silent wall of obsidian and light that marks the boundary of the simulation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic shot of the Host of Heaven standing in a perfect line, their bodies composed of black obsidian and internal plasma light. They are motionless, statuesque figures against a backdrop of digital twilight. The camera focuses on the reflection of the simulation grid on their glossy surfaces. The mood is somber, quiet, and awe-inspiring. Photorealistic textures, ray-traced reflections, dramatic side lighting.
